offering_description.value: Provides investment processing software, outsourced investment operations and asset management to banks, wealth managers, asset managers, insurers, corporations and institutional investors. It earns fees from technology platforms, fund administration and managing investment portfolios.

primary_products.value: investment processing software; mutual funds and collective trusts; portfolio management platforms

primary_services.value: outsourced investment operations; fund administration; trust and fiduciary services; investment management

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks, wealth managers, registered investment advisers, asset managers, insurers, corporate retirement plans, endowments and foundations

end_markets.value: financial services; asset management; wealth management; banking; insurance

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: asset-based management fees for managing funds and investment portfolios; service fees: fees for technology, fund administration and outsourced investment operations; transaction or usage fees: per-transaction or per-account fees for processing and platform use
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: builds investment processing and portfolio platforms sold to financial institutions; service provider: runs outsourced investment operations and fund administration for institutional clients; financial intermediary: manages mutual funds and collective trusts, taking in client assets and investing them
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: Clients across the United States, Europe, Canada, Asia and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: investment processing software, investment operations outsourcing, fund administration and investment management, all serving financial institutions

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling directly to banks, asset managers and institutional clients; partners / resellers: technology and distribution partnerships with other financial service providers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: registered investment adviser, broker-dealer and trust company activities regulated by the SEC, FINRA and state or federal banking regulators
